title: 第348章 果然喝酒误事
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

洛云汐离开后，韩林放出通天法界，在三十倍时间加持下，他仅仅用了一刻钟时间，就将丹田内的真元补充大半。

不过精神和神识的消耗依旧没有半点好转，反而因为运功炼化灵石让他更加的疲累。

他将心神转入识海，发现识海已经彻底枯竭，若原本是一汪充盈的池水，那现在就只剩下一片干裂的池塘。

想要恢复过来，除了好好休息自然恢复外，就只有那种能帮助恢复神识的灵丹妙药了。

灵丹韩林没有，不过妙药嘛。

韩林倒是还有三瓶紫露琼浆，绝对是恢复神识的佳品。

但此物一旦服用，就会让他处于飘飘然的醉酒状态，此地并不合适，所以韩林也只好暂时忍耐。

随后，韩林将通天法界关闭，就开始闭目养神起来。

仙眼进入三阶，已经有好多年了，一直没有继续提升，不是韩林不想，而是条件不满足。

且不说进化需要投入多少资源，就是单单境界修为这一关，他就过不了。

传承记忆十分明确的记载着，仙眼进入四阶，最低门槛也要金丹期境界才行。

为此，韩林也只能望而兴叹了。

“韩大哥，我回来了！”这时洛云汐赶了回来，先将一个储物袋递给韩林，“这里面是二十九具筑基期的尸体，你百鬼仙图不是有用吗，我跟你全部装里面了。”

“二十九具，这么多吗？”韩林惊讶地接过储物袋。

“其中有十具是来自赵家的，十九具是来自那些散修，要不是他们分开跑，死的还要多一点。”洛云汐笑道。

“十具赵家的？你意思是，之前逃跑的四人，被你杀了三个？”

赵家十一人，韩林独自杀了七个，最后四个他实在无力去追了，但洛云汐却暗中追了出去。

洛云汐点头道：“是的，那个叫赵秉谦的有点狡猾，我看你这边遇到麻烦，就没继续追了。”

说着，她又拿出一大堆储物戒储物袋递给韩林。

“这些都是尸体上面收来的储物空间，应该有不少好东西，韩大哥你也收起来吧。”

韩林眼睛微微一亮，选了其中十枚储物戒，“我拿这些，剩下的你拿着。”

“好，那我先保管着。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After Luo Yunxi left, Han Lin released the Tongtian Dharma Realm. With thirty times the time blessing, it only took him a quarter of an hour to replenish most of the true energy in his Dantian.

However, the consumption of energy and consciousness still did not improve at all. On the contrary, he was even more tired because of the refining of spirit stones.

He turned his mind to the sea of ​​consciousness and found that the sea of ​​consciousness had been completely dried up. If it was originally a pond full of water, now there was only a dry and cracked pond.

If you want to recover, in addition to taking a good rest and recovering naturally, there is only that kind of miraculous medicine that can help restore your consciousness.

Han Lin doesn't have a panacea, but it's just a magic medicine.

Han Lin also has three bottles of purple dew nectar, which is definitely a good product for restoring consciousness.

But once this substance is taken, it will make him in a state of drunkenness. This place is not suitable, so Han Lin has to endure it for the time being.

Afterwards, Han Lin closed the Tongtian Dharma Realm and began to close his eyes and rest.

It has been many years since the Immortal Eye entered the third level, but it has not continued to improve. It is not that Han Lin does not want to, but because the conditions are not met.

Not to mention how many resources are needed to evolve, he just can't pass the level of realm cultivation alone.

The inherited memory clearly records that for the Immortal Eye to enter the fourth level, the minimum threshold is the Golden Core stage.

For this reason, Han Lin could only sigh with hope.

"Brother Han, I'm back!" Luo Yunxi rushed back at this time, first handing a storage bag to Han Lin, "There are twenty-nine corpses in the foundation building stage. Isn't your Hundred Ghosts Immortal Map useful? I put them all in with you."

"Twenty-nine, is that a lot?" Han Lin took the storage bag in surprise.

"Ten of them are from the Zhao family, and nineteen are from the casual cultivators. If they hadn't run away separately, more people would have died." Luo Yunxi said with a smile.

"Ten Zhao family members? You mean, you killed three of the four people who escaped before?"

Of the eleven members of the Zhao family, Han Lin committed suicide alone, seven of them. He was unable to chase the last four, but Luo Yunxi chased them secretly.

Luo Yunxi nodded and said: "Yes, the one named Zhao Bingqian is a bit cunning. I saw that you were in trouble, so I stopped chasing him."

With that said, she took out a lot of storage ring storage bags and handed them to Han Lin.

"These are the storage spaces collected above the corpse. There should be a lot of good things. Brother Han, you should also store them."

Han Lin's eyes lit up slightly, and he chose ten storage rings, "I'll take these, and you take the rest."

"Okay, I'll keep it first."
